A colourful diagram illustrating matrix multiplication of two 2x2 matrices. On the left, the first matrix has its first row highlighted with a red box and an arrow pointing to the right. The second matrix has its first column highlighted with a blue box and an arrow pointing down. On the right side of the equals sign, the resulting matrix shows the calculation for the top-left element as a combination of the red row's numbers and the blue column's numbers linked by multiplication and addition signs.
